meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 执行安全审计:检查 OWASP Top 10、认证授权、数据保护等;如含 Solidity 则检查智能合约。最终给出通过/需修改结论,生成报告到 docs/reviews/security-audit-日期.md,并交给 Dev 代理。只记录问题,不修复。
howto.when: 在发布前、涉及认证/授权/数据处理的重大改动后、定期安全审查等场景使用;也可通过 /security-audit 命令启动,可指定路径。

say.text: 请对我的项目执行一次安全审计
say.note: Claude 会运行完整检查并生成报告

say.text: 扫描代码里的密钥和依赖漏洞
say.note: 会检查硬编码密钥和已知 CVE

howto.what_en: Performs a security audit: checks OWASP Top 10, auth, authorization, data protection, etc.; checks smart contracts if Solidity is present. Issues verdict, writes a report, hands off findings to Dev agent. Only documents, never fixes.
howto.when_en: Use before a release, after significant code changes touching auth/authorization/data handling, for periodic security review, etc.; can also be launched via /security-audit, optionally scoped to paths.

say_en.text: Please run a full security audit on my project.
say_en.note: Claude will run complete checks and generate a report.

say_en.text: Use /security-audit to check only src/auth/ and src/api/.
say_en.note: Only those two directories are audited.

say_en.text: Scan the code for secrets and dependency vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Checks for hardcoded keys and known CVEs.
